The first two examples below are projected directly from the accepted Node K001 analysis-view JSON files. Backgammonboard renders the factual starting positions and supported checker movement overlays at build time. The browser does not run an engine, parse GNU output, or apply checker moves.

Run `bash scripts/analysis/render-node-k001-lesson-preview.sh` after pulling this branch to materialize the local Node lesson JSON and SVG assets.

:::
